notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness, and has power 3 or greater.
description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.
